description:
A named cultivar of Camellia sinensis from China.

This is a tea plant cultivar rather than a finished tea, so you are more likely to meet its name in a grower's notes than on a packet. If you find tea made from it, brew it like any other yellow tea and taste what the plant brings.
processing: A plant cultivar, not a processing style: it is usually made into yellow tea, and the method is up to the grower.
harvest_season: Depends on the place and the grower.
appearance_dry: Depends on how the leaf is processed.
appearance_liquor: Depends on how the leaf is processed.
appearance_wet: Depends on how the leaf is processed.
taste_profile: Depends on how the leaf is processed; tea from it usually falls within what yellow teas give.
vintage_note: A cultivar is not sold by vintage. Tea made from it follows the usual pattern for yellow tea, so ask for the harvest year and the grower.
